summary: The current implementation satisfies the saved P0 terminal-state callback safety plan. It adds callback-terminal semantics for cancelled, destroyed, failed, and completed without changing lifecycle terminal transitions; records durable workspace.stale_callback_ignored audit events; guards executor status rechecks, transitions, failure marking, validation finalization, and recovery finalization; prevents stale cleanup finalizers from overwriting terminal state while preserving explicit destroy; keeps failed-PR remonitoring able to reopen monitoring; and extends PR monitor terminal and recovery-dispatch races so stale callbacks do not mutate state, PR metadata, failure metadata, recovery operations, reconciliation, cleanup, or monitor handoff. Required validation passed: 1389 control/service/runtime unit tests, ruff, and mypy.
